tables.name: Size
tables.description: The town's boundary includes the surrounding countryside, its farms and outlying buildings. Modifies Population Overflow; sets the number of locations.

results.name: Very Small
results.description: Up to a few hundred standing structures in an area able to support up to around 1000 people. (+2 to population overflow)

results.name: Small
results.description: Up to 500 standing structures in an area able to support around 2000 people. (+1 to population overflow)

results.name: Medium
results.description: Up to 1000 standing structures in an area able to support around 4000 people. (+0 to population overflow roll)

results.name: Large
results.description: Up to 1500 standing structures in an area able to support around 6000 people. (-1 to population overflow roll)

results.name: Very Large
results.description: Up to 2000 standing structures in an area able to support around 8000 people. (-2 to population overflow roll)
